edit.description: checkTipMoved / revertTipMovedCommit account for a tick that produced more than one commit, not just the newest
softReset call site passes the tick's actual commit count instead of the hardcoded 1

summary: An agent making two commits in one invocation trips checkTipMoved on parent-mismatch, and the soft-reset undoes only the newest — the first commit stays on the tip, un-gated.

per.section: Tip verify — commit only onto the tip the tick started on

tests: an agent that makes two commits in one tick invocation has both undone by the tip-moved revert, not just the newest
a single-commit tick's tip-moved revert behavior is unchanged
acceptance: A multi-commit agent invocation on a tip-moved tick is fully reverted; no un-gated commit is left on the tip.
notes: equilibrium audit, wave durability cluster. One-commit-per-tick is currently asserted only in prompt prose, not enforced — this closes the gap that assumption leaves.

edit.description: superviseLoop's consecutive-identical-failure backstop checks every signature in a tick's provisionFailures, not just index 0

summary: The abort backstop compares only provisionFailures[0]?.signature, so a repeated signature shadowed by a varying sibling at index 0 never accumulates a streak and never aborts.
tests: a repeated provisioning-failure signature buried behind a varying sibling at provisionFailures[0] on every tick still accumulates the consecutive-failure streak and aborts at the threshold
acceptance: The backstop tracks every distinct signature across a tick's provisionFailures, not only the first.
notes: equilibrium audit, wave durability cluster. runFanout pushes a repo-level prune failure first, then per-entry failures — the untagged repo-level class is exactly what a tagged sibling at index 0 shadows today.

edit.description: the --job/FLUME_JOB resolution path refuses a name with no existing state root on every subcommand it reaches except job new; naming the job and the path it looked for; exit 2

summary: A mistyped --job <name> on status/tick/loop/wake/sleep silently materializes a real job directory instead of refusing.

per.section: A job is a state root

tests: flume --job nonexistent status exits 2 and creates no directory
flume --job nonexistent tick exits 2 and creates no directory
flume job new nonexistent still creates the state root
acceptance: Every subcommand reached through --job/FLUME_JOB other than job new refuses a name with no existing state root, exit 2, naming the job and the path.
notes: inbox 2026-08-03. job run <name> rewrites itself into --job <name> loop (spec/cli.md) and must stay exempt: spec/jobs.md's "flume job run <name>" section states its no-existence-precondition as intended, not drift — the refusal has to key off job-new-vs-everything-else, not the flag alone.

edit.description: remove the render branch, its arg parsing, HELP_SUB.render, and its HELP_TOP line
remove every assertion on the render subcommand; add the two tests below

summary: Remove flume render per operator ruling 2026-08-03 — it previews with the wrong fence, the wrong prior-attempt state, and its own re-derivation of pickability that disagrees with the dispatcher's.
tests: flume render is an unknown subcommand and exits 2
no help text (flume --help, flume -h) names render
acceptance: render is gone from src/cli.ts, docs/CLI.md, and tests/cli.test.ts; renderPrompt itself (src/Prompt.ts) is untouched — it is the tick's own render path and a public export.
notes: Operator ruling 2026-08-03, spec side already landed (76dc4807). Breaking CLI change; the changelog is git-mined at cut per spec/cli.md Versioning policy, so the commit body is the record.

edit.description: add maxParallel?: number to Chain.supervisorPolicy, beside quarantineScope/abortThreshold
runFanout/partition resolve maxParallel from chain.supervisorPolicy.maxParallel ?? DispatcherOptions.maxParallel ?? 4
forward the resolved value the same way quarantineScope/abortThreshold already are
cover the override and the byte-identical default

summary: maxParallel is programmatic-only (DispatcherOptions) with no chain declaration, unlike its supervisorPolicy siblings quarantineScope and abortThreshold.

per.section: Supervisor policy is a chain-overridable default

tests: a chain declaring supervisorPolicy.maxParallel overrides the DispatcherOptions default of 4
a chain declaring nothing gets maxParallel: 4 byte-identically to today
acceptance: maxParallel is a chain-overridable default alongside quarantineScope/abortThreshold, per engine-boundary.md's policy-constant rule.
notes: inbox 2026-08-03. No new validation added: spec/pending.md's Fanout partition section already documents a non-positive maxParallel degrading to width-1 batches rather than wedging — only the missing chain-declaration surface is the defect.

edit.description: harvestFriction stamps its destination filename so a retried entry's same-named source file can't silently overwrite an earlier still-unread note; correct the JSDoc's collision-freedom claim to match

summary: harvestFriction composes its destination with no exists-check; rename/copyFile silently replace an existing file, so a retry can destroy an earlier, still-unread friction note.
tests: two harvests for the same tag with the same agent-chosen source filename land as two distinct files, neither overwriting the other
acceptance: harvestFriction's destination naming is collision-free the way writeRevertNote's already is; its JSDoc no longer claims a guarantee the code didn't deliver.
notes: equilibrium audit, friction harvest + retired vocabulary cluster.
